objective: Build a small Python package with two independent, tested utility functions.

components.description: Return value constrained to the inclusive range [lower, upper]. All arguments must be integers, excluding booleans. Raise TypeError for other types and ValueError when lower exceeds upper.
components.requirements: Submit one self-contained Python module exporting the named function. Standard library only; no I/O, network or external dependencies. Do not mutate inputs.

components.description: Replace every run of Unicode whitespace in text with one ASCII space and remove leading and trailing whitespace. Return an empty string for empty or whitespace-only input. Raise TypeError when text is not a string.
components.requirements: Submit one self-contained Python module exporting the named function. Standard library only; no I/O, network or external dependencies. Do not mutate inputs.
